name: U.S. EIA Electricity Data
update_frequency: Monthly and annual, depending on dataset
known_limitations: National and state electricity data can support grid-context analysis, but local facility conclusions still require utility, interconnection, rate-case, and permitting evidence.
notes: Official EIA hub for electric power data, including sales, prices, generation, capacity, plant-level data, and interactive electricity data tools. Phase 35 check confirmed current monthly electricity data release links remain available.
